task.name: Service_communal_trash_bins
task.when: Once per shift and whenever a bin is full

step.action: Inspect every communal trash bin for a full bag, a missing bag, and loose trash.
step.ifThen: IF no bag is full or missing, THEN skip to step 6.

step.action: Put each closed full bag inside 📦 Dumpster.
Ask the Dominatrix where to get the correct replacement bags.
Install the correct replacement bag in every bin that needs one.
Put loose trash around the bins in a lined bin.

passWhen.criterion: Every communal trash bin has a bag and is not full.
No loose trash remains around a bin or the dumpster.
